C-T23/G-14: separate legal-aid policy profile is not configured/offered. Standard Clinic negative guards passed; specialized positive flow not run.
Google OAuth disabled in isolated Auth; UI hides it. Actual email verification, password recovery and secure email sign-in were exercised. Google OAuth was not.

Three genuine Spanish OpenAI calls were exercised in a protected no-database runtime. Wilma tests used actual authenticated routes with provider-unavailable fallback; genuine Wilma AI output was not verified.
Broader participant verifier has eight failures both here and on accepted ba8179; no additional current failure after updating one stale summary-context assertion. Neither run is PASS.

Wilma verifier rejects integration-wide paths, historical exact-path approvals and all-51 gates, and reports consumer-adapter assertions; it is not PASS and has not received a complete final-candidate disposition.
Full lint fails in pre-existing unrelated marketing artifacts. Scoped lint: zero errors, 27 warnings before final two focused UI changes. v25 build/typecheck passed afterward.
Plan section 6.3 requires a first-time reviewer who did not build the screen. That review has not occurred; implementation-agent checks do not satisfy it.
No frozen-candidate integrated campaign, current-branch GitHub checks, authenticated Production owner acceptance, or target-specific integrated Production authorization.

Forgot-password hydration/continuation and configured-provider visibility were corrected; actual isolated email journeys passed.
Program screening capacity now counts actual admitted sessions, without fabricating financial usage; capacity denial and replay passed.
Wilma report previously falsely acknowledged an unpersisted report; it now opens the actual support form and persisted report.
Wilma matter link failed to open the panel on v24 due to Next link hash interception; v25 real click/focus/reopen passed.
Packet-information first-screen Back was a no-op; v25 actual Back/readback controls passed.
Observed heading/contrast/mobile controls were corrected; focused Chromium and WebKit accessibility receipts passed.
harnessAndEnvironmentFailures: Ambiguous/hidden Playwright locators and stale expected labels stopped several focused runs; later scoped receipts retain actual successful interactions.
Harness queries used nonexistent partner_users.email and partner_records.program_purpose columns; queries were corrected and existing created records reused.
Historical database fixture lacked the actual capacity helper and operating-model column; corrected fixture passed the real launch database suite. Prior 37/38 suite result was not called green.
Isolated database schema-cache/baseline drift interrupted capacity and render-worker checks; actual seven-migration fresh chain v6 passed and later actual protected flows passed.
Some browser/server/build operations were interrupted during recovery; see exact retained logs below. No interrupted operation is a PASS.
